question: What timing noise floor and kernel-counter baseline does the landed CUDA F4 large-matrix eliminator exhibit for byte-identical current and control binaries on one Secure Runpod RTX 5090 session delivered through the authenticated no-SSH HTTP batch transport at one exact public source commit?

claims.text: Every current and control execution reproduces the preregistered rank, refuted, pinned, and word-operation values.
claims.if_supported: the A/A session is correctness-admissible for the five fixed matrices
claims.if_not_supported: the session is invalid and no timing comparison is admitted

claims.text: The current and control executables are byte-identical copies from one build.
claims.if_supported: the arms differ only in label, path, and order
claims.if_not_supported: the session is not an A/A control

claims.text: This calibration contains no optimization candidate and cannot establish a speedup.

arms.description: One copy of the exact public source commit's release f4_matrix_bench binary.
A second filesystem copy of the exact current-arm executable built at the same exact public source commit.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Every execution is a known-answer control; the helper rejects any matrix-shape, rank, refuted, pinned, or word_ops mismatch before timing is admitted.

negative.not_applicable_reason: This deterministic A/A calibration makes no yield, discovery, or population claim.

factors.name: binary_bytes
factors.how: cmp and SHA-256 equality are required

factors.name: source
factors.how: the public ref must advertise exactly the registered scientific commit; the pod verifies commit, tree, and git-archive SHA-256 before starting the authenticated result service

factors.name: workloads
factors.how: the analysis helper is the executable workload registry and oracle

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: each arm runs first in three measured rounds

factors.name: process_layout_and_cache
factors.how: one complete warmup per arm and cell is excluded

factors.name: gpu
factors.how: the controller allocation guard and final HTTP hardware gate refuse any other model or count; the fallback runner independently rejects GPUs outside its frozen set, while observed CUDA and driver versions are recorded but not placement-filtered

factors.name: foreign_gpu_processes
factors.how: nvidia-smi compute-process query is a precondition

factors.name: gpu_state
factors.how: pstate, temperature, utilization, memory, power, and clocks are retained per execution

factors.name: profiling_overhead
factors.how: unprofiled A/A completes first, followed by nsys and then ncu

factors.name: provider_placement
factors.how: the controller guards exact pod ID, model/count, minimum vCPU/RAM, image, cloud, hourly price, CUDA syntax, and HTTP port; physical-host exclusivity is not assumed

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: the analysis SHA-256 is recorded before data

factors.name: source_delivery
factors.value: public exact-ref clone with no repository credential
factors.how: local unauthenticated ls-remote and remote commit/tree/archive verification bind refs/heads/codex/runpod-http-instrument-20261101 to ab90adc94d6b6528eba909df9b99499fd0ebe243

factors.name: result_transport
factors.value: authenticated Runpod HTTPS proxy with hash-bound 4 MiB chunks
factors.how: one ephemeral bearer gates GET-only status/results; the controller verifies archive/member hashes, refuses undeclared or pre-existing targets, and deletes only its exact pod ID in finally

comparisons.threshold: exact equality to every expected answer in extensions.workloads

comparisons.reason: measure the same-session timing floor; carries no optimization criterion

seed_derivation.note: The matrices are deterministic and consume no algorithm seed; zero is retained as an explicit unused seed.

instance_sampling.rule: The five cells, primary, and holdout were fixed from the retained 2026-10-07 incumbent study before this session.

blinding.how: Both executables are byte-identical and the fixed analysis has no candidate or performance threshold.

power.note: Six pairs per cell are a requested coarse A/A calibration, not an equivalence test or candidate-effect power calculation; all 6^6 ordinary paired-bootstrap resamples are reported.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: The already frozen scientific estimate is 7200 seconds for one build, 70 unprofiled matrix processes, two Nsight Systems traces, and four Nsight Compute captures. The three-hour cap adds 3600 seconds total: up to 900 seconds for allocation/public fetch, 1800 seconds inside the 9000-second command budget for bootstrap/tool preflight variance, and at least 900 seconds for authenticated result transfer and exact-ID cleanup. No campaign pod was launched.

primary.name: CUDA elimination device interval
primary.definition: The verbose device interval from queued panel work through final CUDA synchronization; upload, download, matrix build, startup, profilers, and analysis are excluded.

primary.name: word XOR operations
primary.definition: The exact pivot-history and trailing-update word count for the matrix elimination.

secondary.name: exact answer gate
secondary.definition: Exact equality of shape, rank, refuted, pinned, and word_ops.

secondary.name: CUDA timeline diagnostics
secondary.definition: One post-A/A CUDA/NVTX/OS-runtime trace per arm on the primary matrix.

secondary.name: hot-kernel hardware diagnostics
secondary.definition: One matching update and panel launch per arm with the five named ncu sections, collected after nsys.

measurement.timed_primary_justification: Elapsed CUDA elimination is the optimization target; identical word_ops cannot measure scheduling, occupancy, memory, or launch overhead. Timing is admitted only inside one requested Secure RTX 5090 HTTP-batch session with byte-identical A/A arms, alternating order, no observed foreign GPU process, telemetry, a hash-bound exact public source, and an observed tierB receipt; observed CUDA/driver versions scope the result but are not exact placement filters. Otherwise wall_valid is false.

placement.cleanup: exact-ID DELETE in controller finally with exact-ID absence verification
placement.stop_backstop: pod-scoped Runpod lifetime stop at 10800 seconds

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed design: 2 arms x 5 cells x (1 excluded warmup + 6 measured rounds) = 70 unprofiled executions, then 2 nsys primary diagnostics and 4 ncu primary kernel diagnostics, then stop.
A binary, placement, tool-capability, warmup, measured-row, or profiler gate failure stops subsequent phases and preserves the incomplete session.

Exactly one allocation attempt is permitted. After success, failure, timeout, invalidation, or incomplete transfer, preserve available evidence, perform the exact-ID cleanup attempt, and do not allocate a replacement under this protocol.

invalidation_rules: any mismatch in rows, cols, rank, refuted, pinned, or word_ops
non-CUDA or non-RTX-5090 backend, wrong visible GPU count, or foreign compute PID
not exactly six measured pairs per cell
profiler diagnostics before the unprofiled gate, or ncu before nsys
a resumed, interrupted, contended, or below-tierB row marked wall_valid
a nonzero status, missing telemetry/report, or overwritten artifact
public source ref does not advertise exactly the registered commit, or remote commit/tree/git-archive verification differs
provider price exceeds 1.19 USD/hour, allocated resources are below 16 vCPU or 62 GB RAM, or observed GPU evidence does not match the guarded RTX 5090 allocation
transport status/result identity, chunk, archive, member, declared-output, or cleanup binding fails
any exact CUDA-version placement filter is applied

decision_rule.text: The session is admissible only when public source commit/tree/archive, authenticated transport receipt, exact pod/GPU/price guards, byte-identical binary and correctness gates, every row exactly once, placement/isolation gates, profiler order nsys then ncu, result archive hashes, and exact-ID cleanup evidence pass. Timing intervals are calibration only and have no performance acceptance threshold.
decision_rule.threshold: all exact gates pass; timing has no acceptance threshold
decision_rule.statistic: per-cell ratio of summed current/control device_ms and median pair ratio
decision_rule.interval: exact ordinary paired-bootstrap 95% interval over all 6^6 paired resamples per cell

graphs: paired A/A device_ms ratios per cell

inadmissible: launching any warmup or measured row before the runner's placement and profiler-capability preflight passes
changing workload, oracle, warmup, repeats, or order after data
using profiled durations in the unprofiled A/A distribution
treating ncu replay as timing or A/A as proof of equivalence
pooling wall times across pods or GPU models
retrying wrong answers, application failures, timeouts, or profiler failures as infrastructure
using, stopping, deleting, or attaching to an unrelated pod
launching before the dedicated public ref advertises exactly the registered source commit
using a private Git credential, local dirty tree, or a different commit as scientific source
applying an exact CUDA or driver placement filter instead of recording the observed versions
accepting an hourly rate above 1.19 USD or resources below the registered 16-vCPU/62-GB class
treating the three-hour infrastructure headroom as permission to add samples or profiler launches
accepting a result without the authenticated transport receipt, result archive hash, or exact-ID cleanup outcome

literature.claim: source-linked prior art, workload, profiler order, isolation limits, and pod lifecycle
landed design, exact five-cell answers, rejected variants, and incumbent kernel shares
Nsight Systems CLI CUDA timeline and summary workflow
ncu filtering, launch count, sections, replay, export, and import
Runpod Pod cloud classes and ephemeral compute scope
unique creation, shipping, fetch, deletion, and lifetime-stop behavior
exact public source proof, guarded allocation, authenticated proxy fetch, strict result verification, receipt, and exact-ID cleanup
Runpod HTTPS proxy URL, public-port authentication requirement, 0.0.0.0 bind, and response-duration constraint

transport.authentication: fresh ephemeral bearer with at least 256 random bits
transport.cleanup: exact newly created pod ID in finally; absence verified by exact v2 GET returning 404

preconditions: the public ref resolves to exactly the registered source commit without credentials
the local protocol is frozen and committed before affected data
the output, receipt, archive, and remote-metadata paths do not exist
RUNPOD_API_KEY is available only to the local controller and provider-injected pod scope

lineage.relationship: new HTTP transport and exact RTX 5090 placement variant; prior fallback protocol is unchanged and remains frozen

prospective_correction.reason: The initial two-hour lifetime instruction could not cover the already frozen 7200-second scientific estimate plus boot/fetch/cleanup.
prospective_correction.change: Use a three-hour stop cap and 9000-second command timeout; the 3600-second total headroom is partitioned prospectively into up to 900 seconds before the command, 1800 seconds inside the command budget beyond the 7200-second scientific estimate, and at least 900 seconds for result transfer and cleanup.
